text.name: Syrian Intervention
text.rules: Record "proxy war" for the rest of the game. SAE spends 2 points on one action. If SAE played this card, at the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: Russia began air strikes in Syria on 30 September 2015 in support of the Assad government, its first major military operation outside the former Soviet Union since the Cold War.
